hero.title: Your bookkeeping, done by an AI agent you can just text.
hero.body: Text, WhatsApp, email or call the CYG Finance assistant. It reads your bank statements, files your receipts, keeps your books up to date and sends you your reports — with real accountants at CYG Finance behind it.

whatWeDo.title: Bookkeeping that <hl>answers back</hl>
whatWeDo.lead: One assistant that knows your books, on every channel you already use — and a team of accountants making sure it gets things right.

agent.title: AI agent
agent.body: Ask it anything about your books by text, WhatsApp, email, phone or the website chat — "how much did I spend on fuel last month?", "file this receipt", "send me my balance sheet". It remembers the conversation across channels, and can even call or text someone for you when you ask.

bank.title: Bank feeds & statements
bank.body: Connect your bank in a few clicks (Canada and the US) and your transactions arrive on their own, or upload your bank-statement PDFs. Every transaction is read and posted as a double-entry row, named and categorised by the rules you set for each payee.

receipts.title: Receipts & attachments
receipts.body: Snap a receipt and text, WhatsApp or email it to us. The assistant reads it, works out what it is and attaches it to the right transaction — everything is kept in one folder per bank account that you can browse any time.

reports.title: Reports & schedules
reports.body: Download your ledger, income statement and balance sheet whenever you like, or let the assistant send them on a schedule — a weekly account status, a monthly financial report, or any message you ask for — by text, email or a phone call.

services.lead: Send it your statements and receipts — it does the rest, and tells you when it needs you.

channels.label: An assistant on every channel
channels.body: Text, WhatsApp, email, call or chat on the website.

statements.label: Bank statements, read for you
statements.body: Upload PDFs and every transaction is posted.

feeds.label: Automatic bank feeds
feeds.body: Connect Canadian and US banks through Plaid.

ledger.label: Double-entry ledger
ledger.body: Every row with its debit and credit, ready for your accountant.

receipts.label: Receipts matched to transactions
receipts.body: Text or email them — the assistant files them.

rules.label: Your own payee rules
rules.body: Set a name and category once; it applies everywhere.

reports.label: Financial reports
reports.body: Ledger, income statement and balance sheet exports.

schedules.label: Scheduled updates
schedules.body: Reports and reminders by text, email or phone call.

calls.label: Calls and texts for you
calls.body: Ask the assistant to call or text someone with a message.

companies.label: Several companies
companies.body: Keep separate books for each of your companies.

currency.label: Multi-currency
currency.body: Foreign-currency transactions converted to your home currency.

accountants.label: Real accountants behind it
accountants.body: The CYG Finance team checks the work and is a message away.

contact.title: Talk to a person
contact.body: The assistant handles the day-to-day, and our accountants are always there behind it. Reach the CYG Finance office directly any time.

footer.tagline: We work behind the scenes, <hl>so you can be on scene.</hl>
